title: Why a 15% Yield on Blue Chip Stocks Worries Even Income Investors
excerpt: A 15% monthly yield from an ETF built on Warren Buffett's favorite blue chips sounds almost too good to question, but the math behind that payout reveals a f...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • OMAH's 15% yield comes from covered calls on Berkshire-style holdings, not dividends, as its striking 305% payout ratio reveals.

  • Coca-Cola (KO) and American Express (AXP) anchor OMAH's equity floor, with KO holding Dividend King status and AXP covering its payout ~4x with earnings.

  • OMAH's 14% price gain plus ~15% distribution has outpaced Berkshire B shares' 3% one-year return, though its 1% expense ratio erodes that edge.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Chevron didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

The VistaShares Target 15 Berkshire Select Income ETF (NYSEARCA:OMAH) markets a headline distribution that few equity strategies can match: a 14.9% trailing yield delivered in monthly payments against a share price of $19. OMAH does this by holding the same public companies that anchor Berkshire Hathaway's portfolio, then layering a covered-call overlay on top. Whether that distribution reflects genuine cash flow from those holdings or something more fragile is the relevant question.

How OMAH Generates Its 15% Yield

Launched on March 5, 2025, this Buffett-aligned ETF now manages roughly $958 million across 102 positions. The equity book mirrors Warren Buffett's largest public positions. As of the April 30 snapshot, the seven Buffett-aligned names include Apple, Berkshire's own B shares, American Express, Coca-Cola, Occidental Petroleum, Bank of America, and Chevron. Those holdings made up roughly 47% of net assets, with Financials at 33% and Consumer Staples at 17%. OMAH's concentrated structure reflects the Oracle of Omaha's long-held favorites.

The underlying dividend yields on those names average well below the fund's headline number. Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) yields 2.5%, Chevron (NYSE:CVX) yields 3.8%, and American Express (NYSE:AXP) yields roughly 1%. The gap between those cash dividends and OMAH's 15% target is bridged by selling short-dated call options against the portfolio. The April filing shows short call positions against Apple, Alphabet, Berkshire, Coca-Cola, and Amazon, with premiums collected up front and recycled into the monthly distribution.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Chevron didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Are the Underlying Dividends Actually Safe?

The equity floor under OMAH is genuinely durable. Coca-Cola posted Q1 2026 free cash flow of $1.76 billion, raised the quarterly payout to $0.53, and carries a Dividend King track record. American Express earns $15.87 in trailing EPS against a $3.80 annualized dividend, leaving payout coverage of roughly 4x. Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) grew Q2 net income 27% and just lifted its quarterly dividend to $0.40. Chevron continued its streak of increases, moving the quarterly payout to $1.78, though Q1 free cash flow turned negative on Hess-related working-capital drag.

  • OMAH 15% 的收益率来自伯克希尔风格持股的备兑看涨期权，而不是股息，正如其高达 305% 的派息率所揭示的那样。
  • 可口可乐 (KO) 和美国运通 (AXP) 是 OMAH 股本底线的支柱，其中 KO 拥有股息之王地位，而 AXP 则用收益支付约 4 倍的股息。
  • OMAH 14% 的价格涨幅加上约 15% 的分配已经超过了伯克希尔 B 股 3% 的一年回报率，尽管其 1% 的费用率削弱了这一优势。
  • 立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而雪佛龙并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

VistaShares Target 15 Berkshire Select Income ETF (NYSEARCA:OMAH) 推出了很少有股票策略可以比拟的总体分布：相对于 19 美元的股价，每月支付的跟踪收益率为 14.9%。 OMAH 的做法是，持有与伯克希尔哈撒韦投资组合相同的上市公司，然后在其之上叠加一个备兑看涨期权。 这种分配是否反映了这些资产的真实现金流，还是更脆弱的东西，这是一个相关的问题。

OMAH 如何产生 15% 的收益率

这款与巴菲特合作的 ETF 于 2025 年 3 月 5 日推出，目前管理着 102 个头寸约 9.58 亿美元。 该股票账簿反映了沃伦·巴菲特最大的公开持仓。 截至 4 月 30 日的快照，七家与巴菲特结盟的公司包括苹果、伯克希尔自己的 B 股、美国运通、可口可乐、西方石油公司、美国银行和雪佛龙。 这些资产约占净资产的 47%，其中金融股占 33%，消费品股占 17%。 OMAH 的集中结构反映了奥马哈先知长期以来的宠爱。

这些名称的基本股息收益率平均远低于该基金的总体数字。 可口可乐 (NYSE:KO) 的收益率为 2.5%，雪佛龙 (NYSE:CVX) 的收益率为 3.8%，美国运通 (NYSE:AXP) 的收益率约为 1%。 这些现金股息与 OMAH 15% 目标之间的差距是通过出售投资组合的短期看涨期权来弥补的。 4月份的文件显示了针对苹果、Alphabet、伯克希尔、可口可乐和亚马逊的空头看涨期权头寸，保费预先收取并回收到每月的分配中。

立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而雪佛龙并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

基础股息真的安全吗？

OMAH 下的股权底线确实是持久的。 可口可乐公布的 2026 年第一季度自由现金流为 17.6 亿美元，季度派息提高至 0.53 美元，并保持股息王记录。 美国运通的往绩每股收益为 15.87 美元，年化股息为 3.80 美元，派息覆盖率约为 4 倍。 美国银行 (NYSE:BAC) 第二季度净利润增长 27%，并将季度股息提高至 0.40 美元。 雪佛龙继续保持增长势头，将季度派息提高至 1.78 美元，尽管第一季度自由现金流因赫斯相关的营运资金拖累而变为负值。
